definitions.position: 0-based index of the correct answer in the order presented to the model
definitions.option_set: unordered set of normalised option strings (lowercase, whitespace collapsed)
definitions.option_set_only_loo: majority correct label among other items with the same option set (restricted to labels on offer); uniform 1/k if no peer; ties scored in expectation
definitions.always_same_position_loo: most common answer position among the other items, among positions the item has
definitions.same_position_given_n_options_loo: most common answer position among the other items with the same number of options
definitions.p_null: share of null simulations (answers redrawn uniformly from each item's own options, predictor recomputed) with accuracy >= observed
definitions.answer_prior_loo_supplementary: offered option with highest P(correct | offered) on the other items
definitions.p_one_sided_approx: longest-option baseline only: normal approximation to Poisson-binomial
